run_optimize_volume: run the optimize_volume script to reconstruct an absorbing volume using volumetric primitives from a 3D grid
build_ellipsoid_factory: build volumetric primitives using EllipsoidsFactory to create a grid of ellipsoids with center, scale, and albedo parameters
test_bounded_adam_optimizer: test the BoundedAdam optimizer for gradient descent with per-parameter learning rates and bounds on scales, sigmat, and albedo
summarize_l1_psnr_metrics: summarize the l1 loss and psnr functions used to compute optimization metrics between reference and rendered images
create_save_asset_pipeline: create a pipeline that saves optimized volumetric primitives as an asset using dict_to_asset and object_to_dict from volprim.io
